stages.label: After Class 8
stages.blurb: Stay on track for SEE and know what a technical stream offers.
stages.tip: Marks in Class 8 do not lock a career. Build reading, maths and one hands-on skill now.

stages.label: After SEE
stages.blurb: Plus Two streams, CTEVT diplomas and health programmes.
stages.tip: Pick the stream that fits the degree you want at 18, not the one friends choose.

stages.label: After +2
stages.blurb: Bachelor degrees in Nepal, with entrance exams, costs and careers.
stages.tip: Entrance exams open in the months after results. Apply to three tiers: dream, likely, safe.

stages.label: After Bachelor
stages.blurb: Masters, professional qualifications, government service and abroad.
stages.tip: A master degree helps most when it adds a skill or a licence, not only a title.

routes.name: Class 9 and 10 (SEE)
routes.about: Community schools are free. Private schools charge tuition plus transport and exam fees. The SEE grade decides the stream you can enter at +2.

routes.name: Technical stream in school (Class 9 to 12)
routes.entry: Passed Class 8 and admitted to a school that runs a technical stream
routes.about: A small number of public schools run technical streams such as agriculture, electrical or computer trades next to the regular subjects. Check with your local education unit for availability.

routes.name: +2 Science (Physical or Biology)
routes.entry: SEE with the college's minimum GPA (often 2.4 or more, higher for top colleges). Maths and Science grades matter most.
routes.about: Physical group (Physics, Chemistry, Maths) leads to engineering and IT. Biology group leads to medicine, nursing and allied health. Entrance cut-offs for good colleges are high.
routes.exam: College entrance test, then NEB Class 11 and 12

routes.name: +2 Management
routes.entry: SEE with the college's minimum GPA
routes.about: Accountancy, Economics, Business Studies and Mathematics or Computer. Opens BBS, BBA, BCA and CA routes.
routes.exam: College entrance test, then NEB Class 11 and 12

routes.name: +2 Humanities
routes.entry: SEE pass in the school's stated grade
routes.about: Sociology, Population, Political Science, Mass Communication and languages. Strong base for BA, BSW, journalism, law and civil service.

routes.name: +2 Education
routes.about: Education stream for those who want to teach. Leads to B.Ed and teaching licence routes.

routes.name: +2 Law
routes.entry: SEE pass; offered by a small number of colleges
routes.about: Law subjects from Class 11. Not required for LLB, any stream can apply, but it gives an early start.

routes.name: Diploma in Engineering (CTEVT)
routes.entry: SEE with the minimum GPA set by CTEVT for the programme
routes.about: Civil, Electrical, Computer, Mechanical, Electronics and more. Shorter and cheaper than a degree, with a clear route to a bachelor through the lateral entry seats and job-ready skills.
routes.exam: CTEVT entrance, then CTEVT board exams

routes.name: Health diplomas (CTEVT)
routes.entry: SEE with Science and Maths grades above the cut-off
routes.about: General Medicine (health assistant), Pharmacy, Medical Laboratory, Radiography, Nursing at diploma level. The fastest way to a clinical job.
routes.exam: CTEVT entrance, then board exams and council registration

routes.name: Diploma in Agriculture or Veterinary
routes.entry: SEE, Science and Maths grades matter
routes.about: Plant science, animal science, veterinary support. Strong demand in commercial farming and extension services.
